research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free contextual prerequisite consolidations. The special conditions remain in parent mathematical formulations; no original-source editing, external missing-definition research, certification or gate changes.

aliases.reason: The closed-immersion source uses a sheaf-ring homomorphism O_X→i_*O_Z induced by continuous i:Z→X, exactly the general compatible structure-sheaf morphism O_Y→f_*O_X used for a scheme morphism after renaming f=i, Y=X, source X=Z. The surjectivity of this map, the direct-image sheaf on a closed subset, its locally section-generated kernel, and the closed underlying homeomorphism are extra parent conditions, not properties of a general sheaf homomorphism.

The independent-random-variables source defines σ(X_n) as the collection of measurable inverse-image sets X_n^{-1}(B), B∈Σ_S. This collection is already a σ-algebra, hence it is exactly the smallest σ-algebra containing that family of inverse images: an instance of the general σ-algebra generated by a chosen family. The special choice of inverse images, measurability, and mutual independence of multiple σ-algebras remain parent-specific and are not collapsed into the Borel topological case τ.
